text:
kai: noticed an upload to backups-prod without cmek metadata, alert fired in compliance dashboard
maria: which principal?
kai: backup-uploader@prod-service. Cloud Audit shows request had no cmekKey field
oliver: did we recently rotate the CMK or change grants?
kai: CMK rotate happened 3 days ago, we created a short-lived grant for backup-uploader with ttl=48h — looks like it expired before the job ran
maria: so uploader had storage perms but no kms:Encrypt grant -> uploaded with default SSE-S3
ci-bot: terraform apply detected: modules/backup/iam -> roles/storage.objectAdmin added at 1718999000
oliver: that explains RBAC drift; legacy module reapplied by a pipeline, re-granting broad storage rights
maria: immediate fixes: revoke objectAdmin on backup-uploader and re-run upload with explicit kms grant, rotate pipeline creds if tied to that principal
kai: I'll run a quick audit query to list recent PutObject events missing cmek header and filter by that principal
oliver: sample GCP query (adapt as needed):
SELECT protoPayload.resourceName, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, timestamp
FROM `logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity`
WHERE protoPayload.methodName="storage.objects.insert"
  AND json_extract_scalar(protoPayload.request, '$.cmekKey') IS NULL
  AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="backup-uploader@prod-service"
maria: long term: add CI gate to prevent reapplying legacy iam modules, require kms:Encrypt permission in backup module, and add monitor for GrantCreate/GrantRevoke events
ai-bot: automated suggestion: enforce organization policy to require CMEK for buckets with name matching 'archive-*'
kai: filing INC-2026-078, assigning to eng-infra and encops. Adding checklist: revoke binding, rotate creds, re-encrypt objects, add bucket policy, update runbook
security-bot: reminder: include proof of re-encryption or deletion in incident ticket before closing
maria: done with revoke, kicking off re-encrypt job for 2 objects found, will update ticket when complete
kai: thanks team. Follow-up: add ephemeral grant TTL alert to the KMS monitoring dashboard
oliver: noted, will add an alert rule for grants expiring within 24h to owners
security-bot: please attach post-incident runbook updates within 72h
maria: will do.
